name: ISO/IEC 25012:2008
application: Define dimensions and use-specific requirements; not an ISO certification

name: ISO/IEC 25024:2015
application: Explicit measures, numerators and denominators; no universal pass ranges

name: ISO 8000-61:2016
application: Detection, responsibility, corrective action and verification
limitations: Public abstract only; no clause-level conformity claim

name: W3C Data Quality Vocabulary
application: Metric/rule/context metadata; no RDF exporter in this release
limitations: Working Group Note, not a W3C Recommendation

name: W3C PROV-O
scope: Entities, activities and agents in provenance
application: Separate source snapshots, validation activities and actors; conceptual mapping only

name: W3C Model for Tabular Data and Metadata
application: Physical structure and logical column/row relationships
limitations: dqguard CSV inspection is not a full CSVW implementation

name: Data Package / Table Schema
scope: Portable tabular field types, constraints and keys
application: Design reference for dictionary; dqguard JSON is its own schema
limitations: Do not label dqguard contracts as conformant Data Packages

name: DCAT Version 3
application: Dataset identity, versions and distributions; no DCAT exporter
limitations: Reference for a surrounding data catalogue

name: WHO Data Quality Assurance tools
application: Combine desk checks with verification and system assessment
limitations: Sector-specific; not a universal statistical certification

name: World Bank DIME Data Handbook
scope: Research data collection, processing and reproducibility
application: Survey preparation, high-frequency checks and reproducible processing
limitations: Operational guidance; not a World Bank endorsement of dqguard

name: ODK form audit log documentation
application: Use source paradata as evidence; device logs do not independently prove interviews occurred

name: OpenLineage
scope: Run, job and dataset lineage events
application: Integration option for operational lineage; no native emitter included

name: CDISC standards portfolio
scope: Clinical research collection, tabulation and analysis
application: Use approved CDISC implementations for clinical submissions

name: Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange
application: Use domain code lists and structural metadata for official reporting

name: Simple Features / sf implementation documentation
scope: Geometry, coordinate reference systems and operations
application: Explicit CRS and polygon boundary checks through sf
limitations: Implementation documentation; not formal OGC certification

name: Approved project dictionary and audit brief
scope: Use, grain, consent, windows, units, bounds and tolerances
application: Every project must approve its own concrete requirements
source_url: User-supplied brief and locally approved contract
